Schnittstelle Result<A>

Typparameter:
A - The type of the success value
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Supplier<A>, Transmogrifyable<Result<A>>, Value<A>, XorValue<Exception, A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Result.Failure, Result.Success
public sealed interface Result<A> extends Transmogrifyable<Result<A>>, XorValue<Exception, A> permits Result.Success<R>, Result.Failure<R>

A Result<A> represents the outcome of a computation that either succeeded and returns a value of type A, or failed and provides an Exception.

This interface is a typical replacement for exceptions in functional style and corresponds to a XorValue<Exception, A>, where Left represents an error and Right represents a successful value.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • toEither

      default Either<Exception, A> toEither()

      Converts this Result to an Either.

      In case of success, returns an Either.Right with the contained value, in case of failure, returns an Either.Left with the contained exception.

      The values are delivered lazily, i.e., evaluated only when needed.

      Gibt zurück:
      an Either containing either the success value or the exception
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • toMaybe

      default Maybe<A> toMaybe()

      Converts this Result to a Maybe.

      Returns a Some containing the success value if this is a successful result, or None if this result contains an error.

      Gibt zurück:
      a Maybe containing the success value if present
